name: 丝绒雾面唇颊两用唇泥款
description: 丝绒雾面唇泥质地，唇颊两用，柔雾显白、易上色不易掉色

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant grids, soft blush-beige #F6EFEA for info and scene shots, warm terracotta #B5564A for accent/close shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte blush-beige counter #F6EFEA, neutral matte board #EFE9E1 and soft lip-mud cream-smear texture
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single warm accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the product across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm soft-matte lip-mud beauty commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, warm terracotta accent #B5564A, soft blush-beige #F6EFEA and charcoal text #2D2D2D; bright soft studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif;  consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end cosmetics photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, full product visible, centered upright
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Packshot at a straight-on eye-level view with the whole product visible and centered upright. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial cosmetics e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清丝绒泥妆的核心利益与质感，秒懂卖点
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward at the product, one softly blurred unit framing the foreground
shots.lighting: soft front key with soft contact shadow
shots.background: soft blush-beige #F6EFEA with one soft terracotta #B5564A cream-smear band
shots.props: one soft cream-smear band of the product as the only prop
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A low angle looking slightly upward at the product with one softly blurred unit framing the foreground, the sharp product at 25-30%. Soft front key light with a soft contact shadow. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA with a single soft terracotta #B5564A cream-smear band as the only prop. Left-. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大唇纹明显、拔干、上色不均的痛点
shots.camera: matched split-screen, identical straight-on camera and framing on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and hard; right panel soft and warm
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera and framing. Left panel: an abstract macro view of dry lips with visible deep lip lines under flat hard light, conveying tightness and fading color, shown without a recognizable face. Right panel: {product} in soft warm light conveying smooth velvet coverage. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA on both panels, soft top light. Each panel carries. The product occupies 50-60% per panel. Negative: no recognizable face, no fabricated claims or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用细腻蓬松的丝绒质地证明柔雾肤感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing fine matte texture
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the cream texture swiped from {product}, from a high 45-degree angle looking down, tight zoom on the soft velvety cream surface with a whipped airy peak. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the fine matte texture. Neutral matte board background #EFE9E1. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 展示刷头与蘸取量，暗示不挑手法易晕染
shots.camera: close-up detail shot focusing on the applicator at a 45-degree downward angle, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft side light with a controlled highlight on the cream surface
shots.props: the open tube resting beside the applicator
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot focusing on the applicator tip of {product} held at a 45-degree downward angle, the soft flocked tip evenly coated with cream, the open tube resting beside it, shallow depth of field with the tip sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft side light with a controlled highlight on the cream surface. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no hands with distorted fingers, no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入日常通勤上妆场景，突出唇颊两用
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid feel over a vanity counter
shots.lighting: soft window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow
shots.props: a folded tissue and a small round cosmetic mirror, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a matte blush-beige vanity counter #F6EFEA beside a small round cosmetic mirror, suggesting a lip-and-cheek dual-use daily routine. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid feel. Soft window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded tissue and a small round mirror, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no recognizable face, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用前后对比证明丝滑覆盖与视觉隐纹
shots.camera: matched side-by-side, identical straight-on camera, crop and lighting on both panels
shots.lighting: identical soft even light on both panels
shots.whitespace: keep a caption strip on each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera, crop and lighting. Left panel: an abstract macro view of lips with patchy uneven color and visible lip lines after an ordinary matte lipstick, shown without a recognizable face. Right panel: the same lip area smoothly and evenly veiled by {product}, a soft blurred matte finish with lip lines visually softened. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA on both panels, identical soft even light. Two clear Balanced occupancy across both panels. Negative: no fabricated results, no exaggerated claims, no recognizable face, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 一次展示多色号，降低选择成本
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay
shots.lighting: even flat lighting, identical across all variants
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay, the product shown as a row of units in several shade variants, all at the same hero angle and identical lighting. Background clean white #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% overall. Under each unit a short color-name in #2D2D2D. Negative: no mixed lighting, no lighting drift between variants, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 讲清色系分类与规格容量，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree angle, product lying flat beside the layout
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: a few rounded info cards in soft white #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}, a top-down 90-degree angle shot with the product lying flat beside the layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA. Stacked rounded cards with thin-line icons in {accent_color}. The product occupies 60-70%. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no fabricated ingredient claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用清晰上妆步骤降风险，建立专业信任
shots.camera: three-panel step strip with flat even framing, product panel at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Panel 1: a bare-lip prep step shown abstractly without a recognizable face; panel 2: the product applicator laying a soft veil of color on lips shown without a recognizable face; panel 3: the product shown at a slight 3/4 angle. Even clean studio light. Background pure white #FFFFFF. The product occupies 50-60%. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data; no recognizable face, no fabricated badges, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用热卖色组合陈列引导下单
shots.camera: group slight 3/4 view with a second unit beside it to suggest a set
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with soft contact shadows
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Background warm terracotta #B5564A. The group occupies 55-60% overall. Negative: no real discount numbers, no fabricated sales counts, no watermark, no fake logo, no invented claims.

provenance.notes: 从 1688 爆款唇泥套图（11 主图 + 6 SKU + 14 详情图）提炼；已剥离原品牌字与国际文案、模特脸、色号文案与运营类开票说明，产品一律以 {product} 占位。SKU 图与主图重复、运营图（开票说明）已丢弃。
